Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick post-call recap and suggested next steps so we can get the Private/VPC architecture review on the calendar.

Recap (from discovery)
- Primary goals: deploy Redwood Private in Novamed's VPC for PHI workflows; strict data residency in us-east-1; HSM-backed key management required.
- Scale target: ~4-8 GPUs during steady state, burst to 12 for monthly batch workloads.
- SRE/Network constraints: need support for cross-account peering and least-privileged NAT egress.

Requested next step
- Technical deep-dive / architecture review with our Solutions Engineering + Ops teams (approx 60–75 minutes). We'll cover VPC design, routing, KMS/HSM integration, audit logs, and rollout phases.

Please pick one of these windows (all in EDT):
- Tue Apr 11, 09:00–10:15
- Wed Apr 12, 13:00–14:15
- Thu Apr 13, 10:30–11:45

Pre-call asks (short list)
- Network contact + brief network diagram (VPC CIDRs, transit gateway usage, VPN/Jumphost if any)
- Point of contact for KMS/HSM & compliance reviewer
- Confirmation of who will join on Novamed side (SRE, Network, Security)

I'm attaching a short pre-reqs PDF that lists details we typically need ahead of an architecture review (arch_prereqs.pdf). Also sharing a drive folder with a proposed agenda and our runbook templates: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/priv-td-novamed.

Goal is to lock a slot this week so Marissa (Solutions Engineering) and Ben (Operations) can prepare the environment-specific notes.

Thanks — talk soon,

Sean Gallagher
